## Research status

**Technical owners.** 3 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [The Virtual Context ABI: Typed Pages, Cells, and Certificates](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/virtual-context-abi.html), [Durable Semantic Memory and Knowledge Lattices](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/durable-semantic-memory-and-knowledge-lattices.html), [Context Transactions, Snapshots, Mounts, and Taint](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/context-transactions-snapshots-mounts-and-taint.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 11.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Simpler retrieval and memory systems matching provenance, contradiction handling, forgetting, transfer, revocation, and cost would justify a thinner layer.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
:::
